\[
  a^T\hat{\beta}
  \pm z \cdot \sqrt{\hat{\varphi} a^T(\mathbf{X}^T\hat{\mathbf{W}}\mathbf{X})^{-1}a}
\]

\[
  \mathrm{AUC} = \mathbf{P}(\eta_0 < \eta_1)
                 + \frac{1}{2} \mathbf{P}(\eta_0 = \eta_1).
\]

\[
  \eta_0 = \eta(X) \mid Y = 0 \quad \text{and} \quad \eta_1 = \eta(X) \mid Y = 1.
\]
